title: CodeChef: Chef and Dolls (Odd Doll Finder)
description: Chef has a collection of dolls. Each doll has a type id. Every type occurs an even number of times, except one type which occurs an odd number of times. Find that odd doll type id using bitwise XOR in O(N) time and O(1) space.
explanation: XOR cancels pairs, isolating odd frequency element in O(N) time and O(1) space.
